records.title: VIZHINJAM INTERNATIONAL PORT-RAIL CONNECTIVITY
details:
(a) to (c): Rail connectivity to Vizhinjam International Seaport is under execution to provide seamless 
integration of the Port with the Indian Railways network and to strengthen multimodal logistics 
capabilities of Indian Railways.
